verdictBody: All three indicators remain well below trigger; continued claims eased to a new 2026 low near 1.70M even as September payroll growth slowed sharply to +29K.

indicators.name: I
indicators.readout: Official IUR held at a 2026-low 1.1% (week of Sep 5); covered-employment base continues to comfortably outpace continued claims.

indicators.name: I
indicators.readout: Continued claims eased further to 1.701M (week of Sep 19), a new 2026 low, while payrolls kept growing, albeit much more slowly (+29K in Sept.).

indicators.name: I
indicators.readout: Initial claims held near cycle lows at 197K (week of Sep 26), showing no sign of the deterioration implied by September's weak payroll print.

stats.label: Nonfarm Payrolls
stats.note: Sharp slowdown vs. 12-mo avg. of +45K/mo; July revised to -10K
